eligibility_summary: US residents who paid (in whole or in part) for one or more prescription drugs at Kroger or a Kroger-owned/operated pharmacy, using prescription insurance benefits, between Dec 9, 2018 and Aug 23, 2026. Proof required only if estimated out-of-pocket >= $8,000.

typical_payout_range: Pro rata share of the $17M fund, based on amount spent on qualifying prescriptions and total claims. Payments via PayPal, Venmo, Zelle, ACH, virtual prepaid card, or paper check ~150 days after final approval.
